question: Who among the following was a renowned Indian Statistician, and was instrumental in formulating India's strategy for Industrialisation in the Second Five Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prasant Chandra Mahalanobis.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prasant Chandra Mahalanobis** was a renowned Indian statistician who was born in **1893 **and passed away in **1972.**
 
• He was a founder of the** Indian Statistical Institute** and made significant contributions to the field of statistics, including the development of the **Mahalanobis distance measure.**
 
• Mahalanobis was also an important figure in India's economic development, serving as the** chief architect of the Second Five Year Plan,** which aimed to promote industrialization and self-sufficiency in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagdish Natwarlal Bhagwati** was an Indian-American economist who made significant contributions to the field of **international trade theory.**

 
 
• **​**He was a professor at Columbia University and served as an** economic advisor** to several governments around the world.
 
 
 
• **Prof. VKRV Rao** was an Indian **economist and educationist **who played a key role in the development of higher education in India.
 
 
• He was the founder of the** Institute of Social and Economic Change in Bangalore.**
 
 
 
• **VR Gadgil **was an Indian politician and** freedom fighter** who was a member of the Indian National Congress.
 
 
• He served as a member of parliament and held several **ministerial positions** in the government.
